title: Cotton on the Moon
purpose: Teach what the Chang'e-4 cotton experiment showed (a seedling) and what it did not (no flowers).

beats.label: measured
beats.card: A sealed experiment, not a garden

captions: In {year}, China's Chang'e-4 lander carried seeds to the Moon's far side.
Inside a small sealed can, a cotton seed sprouted into a green seedling.
So a seed can sprout on the Moon, inside a sealed can.
But it never flowered or made seeds.
That was one small, sealed experiment.
ends_on: A sprout is a start, not a harvest. Growing food on the Moon still has to be proven.
